items.Sentence: Construct a new 80 acre LAA that will be used to grow alfalfa or other crops.
Replace the existing influent pump station pumps with new pumps that provide increased capacity.
Convert seven of the nine existing rapid infiltration ponds into two 60-mil thick HDPE liner equipped effluent storage ponds that provide 120 acft of treated wastewater storage.
Convert the remaining two of the nine rapid infiltration ponds into a constructed wetland that will polish effluent from the treatment ponds during average flow conditions.
Wastewater will be biologically treated in the mechanically aerated treatment ponds.
Effluent from the aerated ponds will be discharged to a settling pond prior to discharge to a constructed wetland during normal flow conditions
Disinfection will be performed using sodium hypochlorite, which will be provided by an on-site generator.
If funding allows, the project will also include the following: i. Install a liner in the existing unlined emergency storage pond.
